register.title: Create your AgriDirect account
register.subtitle: Select your primary operational role to begin direct agricultural trade
register.verification_notice: Registration establishes your platform account and initial profile. Formal document verification is completed separately before produce listings or purchase orders can be created.

register.buyer_desc: For restaurants, hotels, supermarket chains, wholesalers, food processors, and caterers procuring fresh bulk produce directly with clear provenance.
